job: หน่วยงานรัฐกระจุกอยู่ตรงไหน และรอบแปลงมีบริการรัฐอะไรใกล้ที่สุด — แล้วเจาะลงถึงสถานี หน่วยงาน อาคาร และการย้ายที่ตั้ง
audiences: ทีมพัฒนาโครงการและนักลงทุนที่ดิน
ทีมเลือกทำเลค้าปลีกและบริการ
จังหวัด อปท. และหน่วยงานที่วางแผนจุดบริการ
ผู้ประเมินมูลค่าและสถาบันการเงิน
journey: switch the measure (หน่วยงาน | บุคลากร)
district → groups, types, moves and openings, stations, offices
station → offices within 500 m and the nearest services
office → building view, type, personnel, agency, its move, nearest services, offices round it
group or type filter → its card; other places of the dataset on demand
open the same area in CityMETER production
basedOn: CityMETER · Hotel 0.3.6 (montri-th/hotel @177e592f2437d391b0aef953c7c877234cfd9ece) through CityMETER · School 0.1.0: every engine contract carried unchanged; hotel- and school-only features (chain logos, prices, tuition, assessment, comparison sets) not carried

rowScopes.scopeRows: rows after search · group · type · province, before any district selection or focus: the comparison base of the Aha, the choropleth, the charts and every rank
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected เขต/อำเภอ
rowScopes.rows: baseRows narrowed by the district focus: pins with detail, counters, the table

firstAha.ranking: เขต/อำเภอ by the measure (then the other measure, then name) inside the home province = the province holding the most of the measure among rows placed at district level; up to three and never every district holding the measure (N ≤ 3 → top N − 1); never cut through a tie; none left → spread
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {share}% ของ{subject}ใน{home} อยู่ใน {n} {เขต|อำเภอ}นี้ (one district: อยู่ใน{เขต|อำเภอ}{name}); subject = js/model.js#unitFor: หน่วยงานรัฐ · a group (หน่วยงานตำรวจ …, ศาสนสถานและโบราณสถาน …) · a type (สถานีตำรวจ …) · บุคลากรที่บันทึก · สถานที่ทุกหมวด
firstAha.numerator: Σ measure of the focused districts (production membership)
firstAha.denominator: Σ measure of every row of the home province in the selection (homeValue)
firstAha.personality: rail: two bars — share of the measure within 500 m (straight line) of an operating CityMETER · Transit station among the focus rows with a point vs the rest of the province; both bases in each bar’s title and accessible text; hidden when nothing in the province is near rail
firstAha.secondary: the district(s) with the most of the measure outside the home province, every district tied at that value, “มากกว่าทุก{เขต|อำเภอ}ของ{home}” when it holds more than the focus’ first district
firstAha.action: โฟกัส / ดูทุกพื้นที่ (auto focus by default; ?areas=all releases it) · เปรียบเทียบพื้นที่ (charts)
firstAha.filter: every filter of scopeRows; the measure switch; the group scope (other places loaded on demand)

areas: เมืองนครราชสีมา
defaultSnapshot.rail: hidden (no operating station in the province)
outside: เมืองนครสวรรค์

areas: เมืองชลบุรี
outside: เมืองลพบุรี

defaultSnapshot.note: fixtures of release 0.1.0 (tests/insight.test.js, tests/views.test.js), never UI constants

fallbacks.empty: ไม่พบ{หน่วยงาน|สถานที่}ตามตัวกรองนี้ + ล้างตัวกรอง
fallbacks.spread: {n} {เขต|อำเภอ}ใน{home} มี{subject}เท่ากัน …
fallbacks.unplaced: n แห่ง · ไม่ระบุเขต/อำเภอ (none in this release)

firstAha.camera: city preset framing the focus districts; plan when they are spread (> 0.3°)

countingUnitContract.default: offices (แห่ง): one office = a production point or the repeated points of one office (same type and name, same province, chained within 100 m)
alternatives: personnel recorded (คน): Σ officer of the types that record a count at the site
countingUnitContract.rule: unknown personnel counted apart, never 0; a local government counted once per organisation (staffShared); an agency’s whole workforce shown on its head office only (agencyStaff); places of the other groups have no personnel (switch off)

metricContract.areas: Σ measure per เขต/อำเภอ (offices → LDS count; personnel → LI li.supply)
metricContract.provinces: Σ measure per province frame (same family)
metricContract.eligibility: none — totals; ties are never cut (firstAha.ranking)
metricContract.combined: Σ focus ÷ the home province’s whole total in the selection (homeValue; a share, numerator and denominator shown)
metricContract.notDrawn: no per-area or per-person ratio: personnel recorded is not a density, a daytime population or a service capacity
metricContract.ramp: all 41 samples of the family LUT by rank among the measured nonzero values being read (js/scales.js#buildRamp; owner standing rule “Color scale ขอให้ใช้ 41 scales ตาม LDS เสมอ”); map, legend, labels, rank bars and the district chart read one ramp; the matrix has its own ramp over its cells

coverageContract.covered: every เขต/อำเภอ of the 77 provinces is in production’s national scope; 925 of 928 hold a government office

states.measured_zero: sample 0 + zero outline — no office of the scope is placed there under the filters
states.no_data: personnel only: the district has offices but none with recorded personnel (hatch)

coverageContract.unplaced: none: every row sits in the production district of its overlay subdistrict

admin.th: ปกครองและท้องถิ่น

justice.th: ศาลและยุติธรรม

unclassified.th: ยังไม่ระบุหมวด

education.th: การศึกษาและแหล่งเรียนรู้

religion.th: ศาสนาและโบราณสถาน

community.th: ชุมชนและสมาคม

categoricalCueContract.sizeCue: symbol area ∝ recorded personnel (radius = k(zoom)·√(personnel/100), cap 1,000, min 1.6 px; js/model.js#pinRadius); an office with unknown personnel hollow at the 40-person size; places of the other groups filled at that size

framesContract.index: data/area-index.json — 928 districts and 77 provinces, no geometry (codes, names, production areaSqm, label, bbox)
framesContract.frames: data/frames/{CODE}.json — district outlines per province (77 files)
framesContract.loading: the selection’s provinces at once; the provinces under the map at district zoom (≤ 6 per move); never all 77 up front; versioned with the release tag
framesContract.failure: reported and retried on the next request; panels, charts and table never depend on outlines

mapFocusContract.principle: detail only for the focused part — the selected district, the station, the office, the automatic or explicit focus; everything else visible but quiet

states.auto: default top districts; released when none of them is on screen

mapFocusContract.choropleth: count (offices) or li.supply (personnel), 41-sample ramp by rank, under the basemap’s first line layer; zoom 8–14.5; the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4; measured_zero = sample 0 + 2 px zero outline; no_data = hatch

source.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the production point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

rail.drawn: every operating station as a quiet ring from zoom 10.5 (names from 13.5), clickable → station panel; the open station’s 500 m radius dashed
rail.office: nearest operating station within 2 km and nearest station under construction (“กำลังสร้าง”), straight line

events.rule: dated moves, new office buildings and service points 2024–2026 that production does not hold at their new place; linked to the production row the sheet names

ministry.rule: exact name of the row's agency (gov_name; for points without a category also the point's own name) = an agency of OPDC/DGA

services.district: ที่ว่าการอำเภอ (1010)
services.local: สำนักงานท้องถิ่น (1020–1060)
services.police: สถานีตำรวจ (1070)
services.fire: สถานีดับเพลิง (1121)

servicesContract.rule: the nearest office of the kind with a point, straight line, ≤ 30 km, never the office itself; a slot only where production types that service in the point’s province (Bangkok: police and fire)
servicesContract.never: a jurisdiction, a service area, the office to contact

nearbyContract.rule: same group, ≤ 2,000 m straight line, nearest first, ten shown, every loaded row
nearbyContract.around: every loaded row within 2 km (any group) beside it
nearbyContract.heading: หน่วยงานรอบ ๆ

eventsContract.shown: overview and district (newest first, six then the rest folded), the office it replaces (a dated box first)
eventsContract.fields: kind, date as announced and what it means, new and old place as written, the agency’s announcements (public https), the production row it replaces where the sheet names it
eventsContract.scope: the government offices without a type or search filter
eventsContract.never: a map link, a coordinate source, a claim that the move is complete

contextActionsContract.ai: Google Search with a question written for the view (0.3.3: /search?q=, answered at the top by Google’s AI Overview, AI Mode one tab away; never udm=50, which Google stops at “Continue with this search?” from another site)
contextActionsContract.maps: Google Maps search by public names
contextActionsContract.streetView: only with a point (production point, station reference point “ใกล้สถานี”)
contextActionsContract.dataBoundary: Google’s answers are Google’s: never copied into the data

buildingJoinContract.buildings: focus-tier footprints: OpenStreetMap (pieces of one outline cut by tile edges, building:parts, podium + tower grouped) or, inside a CityMETER unit, CityMETER Building V4 (whole buildings, keys cm:)
buildingJoinContract.click: one office → the office; several → the building panel “หน่วยงานในอาคารนี้” (“สูงราว”, the outline source in the title and the provenance line)
buildingJoinContract.nearest: an office whose point falls in no outline is framed on the nearest drawn building (cameraContract.buildingView.target) — never joined, counted or listed

interactionContract.mapClicks: focus pin → the building being looked at (x-ray: frame again) → focus building → station → province view district / province frame (below zoom 8) → district
interactionContract.reframe: every way into a building view frames it again
interactionContract.keyboard: roving tabindex over HTML pins from zoom 15.5; roving tablist for chart views; arrow keys on the measure switch; visible focus everywhere

basemapContract.palette: --basemap-* tokens of assets/theme.css; data colours never set there
basemapContract.water: light: --basemap-water #CFDDE7 (basemap-only, 1.22:1 from the ground) and the shore line water-shore --basemap-shore #B2C7D6 (1.26:1 from the water), drawn above the district fill and beneath footprints and roads; rivers --basemap-water-line; dark: LDS surface.blueTint #18333E with shore #1F3F4C (owner 2026-11-02 “… ดูเหมือนน้ำมากกว่านี้ … แต่ยัง clean and quiet”)

massingContract.cityTier: basemap building extrusions, quiet, faded with distance from the focus; OpenFreeMap features replaced by CityMETER buildings are hidden (one hashed match) and their buildings outside the focus come back in a context layer drawn the same way
massingContract.focusTier: rounded footprints from z14 tiles in the focus regions (≤ 16 tiles nearest the camera; from zoom 12 in 3D when complete, else 13): OpenStreetMap, or CityMETER Building V4 tiles (≤ 40 requests, per อปท. or แขวง) inside CityMETER units
massingContract.hostTier: unused (no host geometry in this product)
massingContract.enclosure: encloseOffsetM keeps the rounded shape around the original outline
massingContract.buildingSource: per unit from data/building-units/ (built by montri-th/hotel scripts/build-building-units.py, copied by scripts/adapt-building-units.py): CityMETER Building V4 when its count ≥ 1.15 × the OSM count of the unit (owner 2026-11-01), else OSM; units the Hotel build did not evaluate draw OSM; OSM buildings mapped in parts stay inside CityMETER units; a missing CityMETER tile leaves its part on OSM
massingContract.terrain: fill-extrusions stand on the terrain at their centroid (MapLibre); the building camera fits on the anchor's ground plane and the landed centre's ground; the x-ray solid is lifted the same way

presets.model: pitch 60 · fov 14 (district, office without a point)
presets.eye: pitch 75 · fov 24 (the building view: building, office with a point)

cameraContract.fitting: fitPitched (overview, district): flat fit, then zoom out until every outline vertex is inside the padded viewport, then in while it still fits; pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3

buildingView.owner: 2026-10-29 19:47 “อาคารที่เลือก หรือ on focus ให้แสดงด้วยมุมมอง 2-point perspective เสมอ zoom to fit viewport เสมอด้วย”
buildingView.module: js/camera.js#fitBuilding, twoPointBearing, wallAzimuth, occlusionScore, screenBounds (from CityMETER · Shopping centers); js/app.js#frameFocus
buildingView.target: js/app.js#focusTarget — the open building; the building the open office’s point falls in, else (the Hotel rule of 2026-11-02 “… ต้องแสดง 2-point perspective ของ 3d building mass ทุกกรณี”) the drawn building nearest the office’s point: js/building-join.js#nearestBuilding — distance from the point to the outline on a local plane, within 300 m (SCHOOL_REACH_M), the largest piece within 10 m of the nearest; when nothing is drawn within 300 m the focus tier is loaded once more for 800 m round the point (SCHOOL_REACH_FAR_M); legend “อาคารใกล้หมุด”, framed with the point (one zoom step wider, maxZoom 20); a camera choice only, never a join, a count or a located-in claim
buildingView.bearing: dominant wall azimuth + 45°, on the diagonal where the drawn focus buildings (massing.obstaclesNear, 400 m) hide least of it, then the one nearest the current bearing
buildingView.fit: eye preset; shift lens (0.3.2, js/camera.js#lensPadding): padding moves the principal point up to the free box’s centre, never below the canvas centre (pitch + fov/2 < 90 keeps the horizon out), so the camera looks straight at the building at pitch 75 on a phone’s strip above the sheet as on a desktop; fit points = the pieces as the focus tier draws them at building zoom (massing.fitPointsOf → js/massing.js#footprintFitPoints: the offset and fillets of zoom 18, ground and roof), never the shape drawn at the starting zoom (up to 3.6 m wider on every side); every one inside the free box (js/app.js#visibleBox: below the toolbar, above the Aha card, legend, chart tray, table or open phone sheet, left of the zoom control), one side filling 94% of it; maxZoom 21 when the building is known (js/camera.js#BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM — offices stand in low buildings across a campus; the Shopping centers limit 19.5 left a 40 m building at half the box) / 18 while unknown, minZoom 14
buildingView.unknown: a 90 m box round the point (12 m tall) framed the same way while the buildings load, and where nothing is drawn within 800 m; the camera turns to the building when it arrives, at most three times, never after a user camera move
buildingView.plan: 3D off: the same footprint fitted flat (fitPitched plan, maxZoom 21 known / 18 unknown)
buildingView.click: selectOffice (pin, label, list row, search) and selectBuilding switch the map to 3D (js/app.js#ensure3d) before framing; a link keeps view3d=0 when it asks for it
buildingView.terrain: on terrain each fit point carries the ground it is drawn on (4th value: roof at the piece centroid’s ground, base at the lowest ground under its outline, the pin at its own ground); fitBuilding damps its landed rounds (half steps) and js/maplibre-guard.js#guardElevationFreeze lands the centre on the ground after every programmatic ease (MapLibre 5.6.2 leaves map._elevationFreeze on); refitted when the ground changes by ≥ 3 m, a new building arrives or the free box changes once the camera is still (js/app.js#watchFreeBox: legend, trays, phone sheet), at most 3 times, never after a user camera move
buildingView.lift: 0.3.2: MapLibre 5.6.2 lifts a camera that would stand inside the terrain (Map#_elevateCameraIfInsideTerrain: lower pitch, other zoom) on every jump; fitBuilding computes with it off (withoutLift) and asks MapLibre’s own check about the camera it found — the alternates (the other corners, opposite first: js/app.js#frameFocus) when that camera would be lifted, else the pitch MapLibre allows; the target carries its pitch and the centre’s elevation (an instant jump checks from the right height)

tileCoverGuard.bug: MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2 SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles checks the four children of a missing ideal tile whenever the cover zoom + 1 ≤ the source maxzoom; a pitched cover can already hold an ideal tile at the maxzoom, whose children() is ONE overscaled child; when that child is retained, children[1] is undefined and the frame throws “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'key')”
tileCoverGuard.seen: live 2026-10-29 (Claude desktop browser, real OpenFreeMap tiles): openmaptiles (vector, maxzoom 14), cover zoom 13, camera 13.79–13.95, pitch 75, while the building camera flew between branches; reproduced in the build container by stepping the pitched camera out from 19.5 to 13.6 over a building (7–8 errors on 0.2.0, 0 with the guard)
tileCoverGuard.fix: pad the child list of exactly those ideal tiles to four copies of the overscaled child, so the check reads as MapLibre's own overzoom branch; installed on the shared SourceCache prototype at every style load; only for version 5.6.2
tileCoverGuard.elevationFreeze: js/maplibre-guard.js#guardElevationFreeze(map, version), 0.3.2: MapLibre 5.6.2 easeTo/flyTo on terrain without freezeElevation leave map._elevationFreeze on (only a gesture or _finalizeElevation clears it), so the render loop stops clamping the centre to the ground and the framed building drifts (seen 2026-11-02: camera 80.97 m vs ground 62.41 m at Sri Panwa); the guard wraps map._afterEase: when the ease ended (not superseded) and no terrain gesture is running, it clears the freeze and sets the centre elevation to the ground; only for version 5.6.2 (tests/maplibre-guard.test.js)

venueXrayContract.owner: 2026-10-29 19:47 “เช็คอย่าให้ 3d building mass ตึกอื่นบังอาคารที่กำลังดูอยู่”
venueXrayContract.module: js/venue-xray.js#installVenueXray(map, {beforeId, toMercator, colors}) → {update(features, {colors}), setEnabled, hitTest(point), dispose, count, enabled, failed} (from CityMETER · Shopping centers / Luxury Brands)
venueXrayContract.layer: venue-xray (custom, renderingMode 3d) before place-quarter (js/map-style.js#VENUE_XRAY_BEFORE): drawn over every building and over road names
venueXrayContract.input: the features of the building being looked at (massing.featuresOf(target.refs)) with display_height_m / display_base_m; on terrain the roof is lifted by the ground at the piece centroid (as MapLibre lifts fill-extrusions) and the walls go down to the lowest ground under the outline (0.3.2; a fixed 10 m showed through the slope)
venueXrayContract.depth: scissored depth clear inside the building’s screen box, then its own depth test
venueXrayContract.seeThrough: massing.setScene('eye', rings): the focus buildings standing in front of it turn see-through (SCENE.eye)
venueXrayContract.labels: district label chips never sit on the building (refreshLabelView avoid box); since 0.3.2 neither do the offices’ name labels (js/labels.js#installOfficeLabels avoid → buildingScreenBox)
venueXrayContract.visibility: 3D only, zoom ≥ 13 (XRAY_MIN_ZOOM); empty outside the building view
venueXrayContract.colours: map.activeLayer faces, map.selectedStroke edges — map roles, not data colours
venueXrayContract.failSafe: a GL error disables it (failed = true); the massing highlight keeps drawing
venueXrayContract.geojsonMaxzoom: every GeoJSON source uses maxzoom 24 (js/map-layers.js#GEOJSON_MAXZOOM, the most geojson-vt allows), two levels above BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM: MapLibre 5.6.2 throws in SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles when the near tiles of a pitched cover reach a GeoJSON source maxzoom before they have data (seen in CityMETER · Shopping centers 2026-10-25); under the eye preset the near tiles sit up to about half a level above the camera (tests/release.test.js)

breadcrumbContract.provinceCodes: production route codes (base info lv0 abbrEn)
breadcrumbContract.datasetCode: governmentOfficer (production CityMETER Government Officer layer, API government-agency, checked 2026-11-06)

provinceContract.fill: the measure below zoom 8 without a province filter

pictogramContract.rule: decorative (aria-hidden); the text carries the meaning; no star

panel.provenance: exactly one line per view: dataset · source (+ announcements / Transit / terrain when shown) · date · boundary, then “วิธีนับ” (DATA_METHOD.md); no caveat on screen

reconciliation.rule: rows and Σ officer per production district × category equal government-agency info lv0

excludedFields: production_row_id (full UUID; the key is its first 10 hex)
map links and coordinate source links (06 แหล่งพิกัด)

visualSystem.themes: light and dark; analytical HEX identical on both
visualSystem.fonts: Bai Jamjuree · IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped · Arvo · JetBrains Mono (assets/lds/build-kit)

invariants.rule: unknown personnel is never 0 (counted apart; district no_data under personnel; tiles “—”; chips read offices)
one office per production point or per repeated points of one office (≤ 100 m, same type and name, same province); every production point in exactly one row
rows and Σ officer per production district × category equal production’s government-agency info (the build stops otherwise)
membership is the production district of the point’s overlay subdistrict; never re-assigned on screen
distances are straight lines between reference points; never walking time, a jurisdiction or a catchment
the Aha never cuts a tie and never focuses every district holding the measure
every panel view ends with exactly one provenance line and carries no caveat on screen
a local government’s personnel is counted once per organisation; an agency’s whole workforce is shown on its head office only
the nearest services name only services production types in the point’s province
places of education, religion and community load on demand and read as “สถานที่” without personnel
no telephone, e-mail, address, website, full UUID, office id, researcher note, map link or private link is published
colours only from assets/theme.css, js/scales.js and js/cues.js; all 41 samples of every ramp; no star cue
